integrity: The all-parameter theorem is proved analytically. The finite exact-rank checker is corroborative only and is not used to infer the infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the source-defined rescaled family \(H_g\), not the unrescaled physical output family.
No optimality or saturation claim at photon number \(m-1\) is made.
The result is existential for a specially chosen fixed-observable polynomial.
title: Fixed-observable multi-photon spectral reach extends through \(\min\{n,m-1\}\)
